name: star-bpa-poc-tooling
description: Repo tooling for the STAR BPA POC: BPMN lint (09 L10). Application code lives in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.lint:bpmn: node -e "require('fs').readdirSync('models/bpmn').some(f=>f.endsWith('.bpmn'))||(console.error('lint:bpmn: no .bpmn files in models/bpmn'),process.exit(1))" && bpmnlint --max-warnings=0 "models/bpmn/*.bpmn"
